[SWS_CM_10174] Mix of signal-based and SOME/IP communication
⌈
A
combination of signal-based network binding and SOME/IP network binding shall be
possible in a way to support the reception of a mix of signal-based communication and
SOME/IP communication within a single UDP datagram or a single TCP stream on one
UDP/TCP socket. Such a mix can occur when using [17] with enabled PDU-header
option on the sender side.
⌋
